allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Fourteen years after Third Impact, Shinji Ikari awakens to a world he does not remember. He hasn't aged. Much of Earth is laid in ruins, NERV has been dismantled, and people who he once protected have turned against him. Befriending the enigmatic Kaworu Nagisa, Shinji continues the fight against the angels and realizes the fighting is far from over, even when it could be against his former allies. The characters' struggles continue amidst the battles against the angels and each other, spiraling down to what could inevitably be the end of the world.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Awakening into a ruined future where your friends are now foes, whom can you trust when the next clash could end everything?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Fourteen years after Third Impact, Shinji Ikari awakens unaged in a devastated world where NERV is dismantled, his former allies have turned hostile, and he must navigate a new battle alongside the enigmatic Kaworu.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Immersive and heavy sci-fi action filled with dread, suspenseful escalations, and brisk, concentrated apocalyptic conflict.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: A fast-moving, emotionally heavy sci-fi drama that plunges into apocalyptic dread, pitting former comrades against each other in intense, high-stakes animated warfare.

'Alongside the enigmatic Kaworu' is a light inference from 'Befriending the enigmatic Kaworu, Shinji continues the fight'. 'A new battle' loosely restates the continued fight against the angels. Neither adds a new plot mechanic, relationship outcome or identity.

The curiosityHook's 'friends are now foes', 'whom can you trust', and 'the next clash could end everything' are rhetorical reframings of the turned-against-him premise and the overview's 'what could inevitably be the end of the world'. The hook is interrogative and does not assert a new fact. 'Ruined future' matches 'Much of Earth is laid in ruins'.
